biocontainers.name: bioconductor-bgeecall
biocontainers.summary: Automatic RNA-Seq present/absent gene expression calls generation

biotools.summary: BgeeCall allows to generate present/absent gene expression calls without using an arbitrary cutoff like TPM<1. Calls are generated based on reference intergenic sequences. These sequences are generated based on expression of all RNA-Seq libraries of each species integrated in Bgee (https://bgee.org).
